name: quill
description: Open-source forms platform — clone-and-run on SQLite, deploy anywhere.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run db:setup && turbo run dev
scripts.dev:pg: docker compose up -d --wait db && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://quill:quill@localhost:${PG_PORT:-5432}/quill pnpm run db:setup && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://quill:quill@localhost:${PG_PORT:-5432}/quill turbo run dev
scripts.db:setup: pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
